title: CodeLift: Your Test Suite Is Secretly a Dense SWE Curriculum
abstract: arXiv:2610.17224v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The pass-all-test binary reward has become a standard recipe for training software engineering agents, but its sparsity eliminates difference of partially correct patches. The test pass-rate is a natural alternative. However, we find that it is not a reliable indicator of patch quality. A functionality being tested can be covered by either one challenging test or one hundred trivial tests, where the majority might be already satisfied pass-to-pass tests. We introduce CodeLift, a reinforcement learning method that dynamically calibrates pass-rate rewards, turning the test suite into an adaptive curriculum. At each iteration, CodeLift groups tests that kill the same patches and patches that pass the same tests, then gives more weight to test groups that fewer patch groups pass. translated_title: CodeLift：你的测试套件其实是一套密集的软件工程训练课程
translated_abstract: “全部测试通过”的二值奖励已成为训练软件工程智能体的标准做法，但其稀疏性抹去了部分正确补丁之间的差异。测试通过率是一种天然的替代方案，然而我们发现它并不能可靠地反映补丁质量：一个被测试的功能既可以由一个具有挑战性的测试覆盖，也可以由一百个简单的测试覆盖，而其中大多数可能早已是已被满足的“通过-通过”测试。我们提出了CodeLift，一种强化学习方法，它动态校准通过率奖励，将测试套件转变为自适应课程。在每次迭代中，CodeLift将“杀死”相同补丁的测试归为一组、将通过相同测试的补丁归为一组，然后为通过补丁组更少的测试组赋予更高的权重。这降低了大量简单测试的影响，使训练更聚焦于仍然具有挑战性的内容。在每个rollout内，CodeLift对补丁应用相同的评分规则（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: CodeLift通过在每次迭代中对测试与补丁进行分组、并给少数补丁能通过的测试组赋予更高权重，动态校准测试通过率奖励，把测试套件转化为自适应课程，为软件工程智能体的强化学习提供更可靠的密集奖励信号。
en_tdlr: CodeLift dynamically calibrates test pass-rate rewards by grouping tests and patches each iteration and upweighting test groups that fewer patches pass, turning the test suite into an adaptive curriculum that provides denser and more reliable rewards for training software engineering agents.
